SEO AUDIT

Central Avenue Dental — SEO audit

Four focused fixes, with exact evidence.

152 sitemap URLs · 161 distinct HTML pages · read-only · October 7

Below-fold photos load before they are neededSchema points to malformed or wrong identitiesThe desktop hours card opens Thursday too earlyFour retired sitemaps remain in Search ConsoleFix order
01

Below-fold photos load before they are needed

The homepage eagerly downloads a 3.38 MB team photo and 864 KB doctor photo below the mobile first screen; the desktop video also transfers about 12 MB.

  • Serve smaller responsive team/doctor photos and load their CSS backgrounds near visibility, preserving quality.
  • Optimize the approved desktop video with a lightweight fallback; retest without changing tracking or Cherry.
02

Schema points to malformed or wrong identities

109 Article publishers have a malformed X link, the practice is typed as a Person author, and Dr. Abbas’s Person.url sends visitors to an image.

  • Fix publisher.sameAs to https://x.com/CentralAvDental and use approved Organization attribution for practice-authored articles.
  • Change only the provider Person.url to /about/dr-kristin-abbas/; keep valid Dentist details and the working image route.
03

The desktop hours card opens Thursday too early

The desktop homepage card says Monday–Thursday 7 AM–3 PM, but the GBP and correct footer list Thursday 8 AM–3 PM.

  • Change #text_block-25-14 to Mon–Wed 7 AM–3 PM and Thursday 8 AM–3 PM.
  • Keep the correct footer/schema and selected Friday dates unchanged.
04

Four retired sitemaps remain in Search Console

Search Console retains four errored sitemap submissions whose exact endpoints return 404, while the current sitemap and working aliases remain healthy.

  • Remove only category-sitemap1.xml, category-sitemap.xml, testimonial-sitemap.xml and video_blog-sitemap.xml submissions after confirming retirement.
  • Keep sitemaps.xml, current post/page feeds and working historical aliases.

Fix order

Correct the narrow hours/schema sources, reduce confirmed eager media, then remove only retired sitemap submissions.

  • Website: approved responsive media, one schema package and the desktop Thursday line.
  • SEO: retire four obsolete feeds; review wider discovery opportunities against existing work.

Keep approved Cherry, badges, tracking and current work; large media transfer does not prove the sole LCP cause.
